commitResults.messageTitle: Set up LittleDaisy with a greeting and a farewell
commitResults.messageBody: Rename Duke.java to LittleDaisy.java so the bot has its own identity, and print a figlet banner, a welcome line and a sign-off. say() takes varargs so replies of any length share the same divider styling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Echo user input until bye
commitResults.messageBody: Add a chat() loop between the greeting and the sign-off: read one trimmed line at a time and repeat it back, stopping on 'bye'. Guard the loop with hasNextLine() so input that ends without 'bye' exits cleanly instead of throwing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store user input as tasks and list them
commitResults.messageBody: Level-1 only echoed each line back. Keep the lines instead, in a fixed-size array of 100 as the increment allows, so that a list command can show them as a numbered list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add mark and unmark commands
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a Task class so a task carries its own done flag and knows how to render itself, instead of the chatbot holding bare strings. This keeps the display format next to the data, which the task subclasses in the next increment can then override.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support todos, deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody: Give each kind of task its own subclass of Task, so that the type icon and any extra times are rendered by the task itself. The list, mark and unmark code stays as it was, since it only ever asks a Task for its string form.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject bad input with friendly error messages
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce LittleDaisyException, thrown wherever input cannot be acted on: an unknown command, an empty description, a missing /by, /from or /to, or a task number that is absent, non-numeric or out of range. A single catch in the command loop prints the message, so the conversation survives every mistake instead of crashing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete command, store tasks in an ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody: Removing from the middle of a plain array would mean shifting every later element by hand, so swap the array and its separate count for an ArrayList, which tracks its own size and closes the gap on remove. The delete command reuses parseTaskNumber, so bad task numbers are already handled.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace command-word strings with a Command enum
commitResults.messageBody: The eight command words were a closed set pretending to be free-form strings. An enum makes the set explicit, lets the dispatch become a switch the compiler can check for coverage, and folds unknown input into the same type via an UNKNOWN constant, so lookup never returns null.

commitResults.messageTitle: Persist task changes across application runs
commitResults.messageBody: Store tasks in a relative data file after each mutation and restore them at startup. Create missing directories automatically and reject malformed saved records with a user-facing error.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 to add task persistence
Parse deadline dates with java.time
commitResults.messageBody: Store deadline due dates as LocalDate values, accept ISO yyyy-MM-dd input, and render dates in a user-friendly format. Report invalid calendar dates without terminating the chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 to add structured deadline dates
Separate application responsibilities into OOP components
commitResults.messageBody: Extract console interaction, command parsing, task-list management, and persistence into Ui, Parser, TaskList, and Storage classes. Keep LittleDaisy focused on coordinating those collaborators while preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-MoreOOP to separate application responsibilities
Organize classes into responsibility-based packages
commitResults.messageBody: Move application, command, task, storage, UI, and exception classes into packages rooted at littledaisy while keeping src/main/java as the source root. Update the setup instructions to point to the packaged main class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Packages to organize the source tree
Merge add-gradle-support to introduce the Gradle wrapper
Configure Gradle for the littleDaisy application
commitResults.messageBody: Point the application plugin at the packaged main class and make first-time wrapper downloads resilient to slow connections. Verify clean compilation and execution on Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for parsing and persistence
commitResults.messageBody: Exercise valid and invalid command parsing, task-number validation, structured dates, storage round trips, missing files, automatic directory creation, and malformed records using isolated temporary directories.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-JUnit to add automated regression tests
Name the executable distribution littleDaisy.jar
commitResults.messageBody: Configure the Shadow plugin to produce a clearly named fat JAR whose manifest launches littledaisy.LittleDaisy. Verify it from an otherwise empty directory using java -jar.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Jar to configure the executable distribution
Document public APIs and package responsibilities
commitResults.messageBody: Add package-level overviews and complete parameter, return-value, and exception contracts for public APIs. Verify the generated documentation with strict doclint checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align code with the Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody: Use the prescribed switch indentation, restrict fields to the narrowest useful visibility, and declare the exception serialization identifier so the code remains clear and warning-free.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add case-insensitive task search
commitResults.messageBody: Let users locate tasks by a keyword in their descriptions without needing to remember capitalization. Reject empty searches and cover matching and non-matching cases with tests.
